units.source_text: 这里林立着好几百座旧石塔，被称作什么“无缘佛”。

en.t: Several hundred old stone pagodas stand clustered here, called something like “unconnected Buddhas.”

units.source_text: 近来偶尔也有些摄影协会让一些女子穿着薄得出奇的衣裳，站在小石塔丛中照相。

en.t: Recently, now and then, some photography associations have women dress in surprisingly thin clothing and stand among the small stone pagodas to be photographed.
Today is probably the same sort of thing.
